title: Event body: hive.journal.tail-repaired
description: The journal's own repair event. A final line without its line feed, an append that was never acknowledged, was removed before this line was appended. The event's basis is the journal's own record: kind record, a ref with schema hive.journal and id equal to segment, and the last intact home_sequence before the repair is this event's home_sequence minus one. See spec/events.md.

segment.description: The file name of the segment the bytes were removed from.

removed_bytes.description: The length of what was removed.

removed_digest.description: The digest of the bytes removed, taken before the removal.
